cells.gaps: The declaration's period ended in 2021 and no row shows a successor sector policy adopted or in preparation: the 2023 Internet Society study only recommends that the State update it. Nothing is held on a mandated body, finance, a report against the policy's targets or any event in the twelve months to the as-at; the adoption year 2016 rests on one secondary summary.
cells.note: Déclaration de politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique: adopted and public, but its period ended in 2021 with no successor sector policy in preparation, so it is expired and places nothing. A national digital strategy is held, which is noted and cannot be its successor, so the cell is unplaced rather than stage 2 or 3.
